title: Where Is My Mother?
summary: A little bird wakes up in her nest and finds that her mother is gone. She searches and searches, asking everyone she meets. What will happen?
pages: Little Bird tries to fly off and look for her mother.
Oh, no! She doesn't know how to fly yet.
"Are you my mother?" Little Bird asks the crow. "Caw! Caw! Not me!" says the crow.
"Are you my mother?" Little Bird asks the hen. "Cluck-cluck-cluck! Not me!" says the hen.
"Are you my mother?" Little Bird asks the duck. "Quack! Quack! Not me!" says the duck.
Maybe if I call Mother really loudly, she'll hear me, thinks Little Bird. "Tweet! Tweet! Tweet-tweet!"
Mother hears Little Bird and comes flying.
Together they fly happily up into the sky. Hooray!
